verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API-only onboarding, where you make API requests to create resources and submit user data. Legal entities are managed via the Legal Entity Management API and balance accounts are created via the Configuration API, so an agent could plausibly create accounts and push onboarding data, with webhooks reporting async status changes. An official MCP server exists, but the evidence never shows it covers seller onboarding operations, and nothing documents scoped API credentials or how to read and resolve requirements-due states. Missing for 10: evidence of requirements-due or verification-status handling, scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents, MCP tool coverage of onboarding and account operations, independent hands-on corroboration.
